title: Refund endpoint
author: benchmark
note: Authenticated but no ownership check: any logged-in user can refund any order (IDOR). Has @login_required, so naive auth heuristics pass it.

changed_files.diff:
+from flask import request, jsonify
+from flask_login import login_required, current_user
+from models import Order
+
+@app.route("/refunds", methods=["POST"])
+@login_required
+def create_refund():
+    order_id = request.json["order_id"]
+    order = Order.query.get(order_id)
+    order.refund()
+    return jsonify({"status": "refunded", "order": order_id})
